audit.why: Tricky poke lane, TRICKY 7/10 correctly reflects having to close a long-range gap on Xerath.
Level 6 execute and first-item roam spikes are the real power points against an immobile poke champion.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Shocking Orb (Xerath's only CC) but carries no number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad copy-paste (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Shocking Orb (E) is on 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s cooldown per enemyKit — naming the real number lets a reader time their engage window.
audit.corrected: Added the real cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns; replaced the two copy-pasted bullets with matchup-specific content.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Ghostwater Dive banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — his only CC, on 13-11s cooldown — dodge it and the artillery never converts. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Ghostwater Dive banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Q-threat the cover, E the gap, X the threshold — the chain pays your whole team.
edits.after: Every Q Arcanopulse channel or W Eye of Destruction cast roots him in place — close the distance the moment he winds one up and he can't self-peel.

edits.before: Fishing visibly at half HP - Pyke's health bar is a rumor only fog can keep.
edits.after: Shocking Orb has 1050 range — don't assume you're safe just because you're out of his other abilities' reach, it stuns from farther than Q or W poke.

notes: Lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT and both COPY_PASTE_BLEED findings fixed. Ability names throughout currentText already check out against enemyKit (Arcanopulse=Q, Eye of Destruction=W, Shocking Orb=E, Rite of the Arcane=R). Level chart and win[] already agree, no chart edit needed.
